title: Introducing Yourself & Polite Greetings in Hungarian

sections.heading: Introducing Yourself
paragraphs: To introduce yourself in Hungarian, start with 'A nevem…' (My name is…) or 'Én … vagyok' (I am …).
Hungarians usually say their first name first, followed by the family name in more formal settings.
Adding 'Örvendek' (Nice to meet you) is polite when meeting someone new.
list: A nevem Anna. – My name is Anna.
Én Péter vagyok. – I am Péter.
Szabó István vagyok. – I am István Szabó.

sections.heading: Polite Greetings & Expressions
paragraphs: Hungarian greetings depend on the time of day.
Use 'jó reggelt' in the morning, 'jó estét' in the evening, and 'szép napot' during the day.
Politeness phrases like 'köszönöm' (thank you) are often followed by 'nincs mit' (you're welcome).
